summary: @onereach/si-header preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue input header component but its `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes the extracted `bun` binary via `execFileSync` to run the bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (string-array + rotating shuffle function `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header indicating it was bundled specifically for the Bun runtime) and its behavior cannot be reviewed from source. Fetching a separate JS runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated sibling file is unrelated to the declared purpose of a Vue UI component, bypasses Node-based scanners, and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
